actions.name: diabolical restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: magic rope
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has a magic rope. While bearing it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use the [[/item .mmEntanglingRope]] action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it is 5+ feet away from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} for 1 hour or more, or if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can fully restore it when finishing a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item .mmWitheringSword]] attacks and can use [[/item .mmEntanglingRope]].

actions.name: parry
actions.desc: Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is [[lookup @activation.condition activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]]. Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} adds [[lookup @roll.formula activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]] to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

actions.name: entangling rope
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=n8nEah4vbrEPphNF]], one creature the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=n8nEah4vbrEPphNF]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the rope is destroyed, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses a Bonus Action to release the target, or the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses Entangling Rope again.
